title: Senior Web Analytics Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Web Analytics Specialist to lead our data governance and analytics implementation initiatives. This role will be responsible for ensuring high-quality, consistent web data collection, building scalable reporting views, and translating business needs into actionable insights.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Layer Governance:
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive Data Layer governance framework to ensure consistency and accuracy across platforms.
  • Define data standards, documentation, and quality assurance processes.

Implementation & Optimization:

  • Implement Data Layer in existing legacy views and ensure seamless integration with analytics tools (e.G., GA4, GTM, etc.).
  • Collaborate with developers and product teams to validate data tracking and ensure business KPIs are captured correctly.

Analytics & Reporting:

  • Create and manage first analytics views and dashboards in Looker Studio (formerly Google Data Studio).
  • Visualize key metrics and performance indicators for different stakeholders.

Business Understanding:

  • Partner with business and marketing teams to understand data needs, define metrics, and develop measurement frameworks.
  • Translate business objectives into quantifiable KPIs and analytical insights.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in Web Analytics or Digital Analytics.
  • Strong expertise in Google Tag Manager , GA4 (Google Analytics 4) , and Looker Studio .
  • Experience designing and maintaining data layers across complex digital environments.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, validation, and tracking methodologies.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for business teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with JavaScript and front-end implementation debugging.
  • Familiarity with BI tools beyond Looker Studio (e.G., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Exposure to CDPs (Customer Data Platforms) or server-side tagging.


Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of our analytics infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across data, marketing, and product.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment focused on data-driven growth.

O DESAFIO

● Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados no Databricks, desenvolvendo código otimizado em Apache Spark (PySpark/Scala) para processar grandes volumes de dados provenientes de sistemas transacionais e logs.

● Projetar e manter estruturas de dados no MongoDB para armazenar e consultar dados semi-estruturados ou não relacionais, definindo modelos de documentos adequados e índices para garantir desempenho nas consultas.

● Integrar o MongoDB ao ecossistema da plataforma de dados, implementando pipelines que migrem ou sincronizem dados entre o MongoDB e outros repositórios (por exemplo, Data Lake ou PostgreSQL), conforme necessário para o projeto.

● Otimizar a performance de jobs e consultas, ajustando configurações de cluster Databricks/Spark (particionamento, paralelismo) e realizando otimizações no MongoDB (por meio de gestão de índices, sharding ou replicação, se aplicável).

● Colaborar com o Tech Lead e Arquiteto de Dados para garantir que as soluções implementadas em Databricks e MongoDB estejam alinhadas à arquitetura global e atendam aos padrões de qualidade e segurança.

● Identificar gargalos ou problemas de dados (ex: inconformidades, atrasos no pipeline, falhas de integração) e propor soluções eficazes, implementando melhorias de forma proativa.

● Documentar os processos desenvolvidos (notebooks, scripts, configurações do cluster, estruturas do MongoDB) para facilitar a manutenção futura e a transição para a fase de sustentação após o projeto.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Atuação em projetos de Big Data e processamento distribuído.

● Domínio da plataforma Databricks e do ecossistema Apache Spark (incluindo escrita

de jobs em PySpark e/ou Scala), com experiência em otimização de jobs, gerenciamento de clusters e uso de Delta Lake.

● Experiência avançada com MongoDB, incluindo design de coleções, consultas complexas (Aggregation Framework), índices e boas práticas de desempenho e replicação.

● Familiaridade com linguagens de programação e scripts para manipulação de dados (Python, Scala e SQL), assim como uso de APIs e conectores para integração entre Spark, MongoDB e outros sistemas.

● Conhecimentos de sistemas de mensageria/streaming de dados (ex: Kafka) para trabalhar com integrações em tempo real, caso parte dos dados seja recebida via streams.

title: Associate Sales Manager
description:
Associate Sales Manager – Sao Paolo

Multinational company is looking for a Sales Manager team lead, in charge of leading 3 team members and carrying their own quota. This is a hybrid role where you would have to go to the office 3 days a week.


Job purpose:

To lead a group of 3 – 4 Sales Associates in their day-to-day sales activity. To drive revenue growth through managing your team with their opportunity portfolio, personal marketing activity & personal development. Your role will be compounded by owning your own opportunity portfolio as well;
supporting clients in assessing their Human Capital Management strategy & demonstrating why ADP should be their chosen partner.


Key objectives:

  • Responsible for the development & maintenance of a comprehensive plan for team sales activity including pipeline and productivity. Responsible for managing both personal and team quota.
  • Responsible for supporting the wider Leadership group of all active sales processes within the team, ensuring co-ordination of company resource in an optimal and effective manner.
  • To fulfil the standard accountabilities of a Sales Associate in addition to the above objectives.


Key duties/tasks:

  • To monitor the performance of the team daily, co-ordinating resource, monitoring activity, and where necessary initiating corrective action with Regional Sales Manager to ensure sustainable delivery of results.
  • To generate new business through inbound leads but also personal marketing efforts.
  • To execute on personal quota plus part of team target
  • To manage sales opportunities through direct reports
  • Weekly team & leadership sales forecasting.
  • To work alongside your fellow Leaders in identifying training & development needs across the wider team.
  • Delivering training sessions (ad-hoc)
  • To submit the relevant management reports in a timely manner including up to date forecasting information.
  • Be result driven to ensure a laser focus on overachievement on quota.
  • Responsible for the direction of the team with regards to training, engagement & development.
  • Member of the sales leadership team.


Skills and knowledge:

  • Ability to anticipate, identify and analyse problems and opportunities, establish priorities and effectively apply resolutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of commercial/sales issues preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment.
  • Ability to review and measure progress against specific criteria and take necessary corrective action where appropriate.
  • Must be able to demonstrate excellent communication skills, personal integrity and a positive attitude in all dealings with colleagues/clients.


Education and experience:

  • Must be able to demonstrate extensive direct selling experience, preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment and consistent over performance
  • Team Leader/Sales Management experience (desirable).

- Supervisionar pedidos, recebimento e armazenamento de bebidas, alimentos e materiais de limpeza.

- Engajar e desenvolver a equipe, fortalecendo o senso de pertencimento e profissionalismo.

- Participar de reuniões com os sócios para apresentar resultados e propor melhorias.

- Manter o equilíbrio entre eficiência operacional e o clima criativo, diverso e descontraído que define a Firma.


Requisitos

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em gestão operacional de bares, restaurantes ou casas noturnas.

- Domínio prático de rotinas de cozinha, bar e salão (fluxo de pedidos, controle de CMV, armazenamento e manipulação de alimentos).

- Capacidade de liderança com postura firme, empática e justa.

- Organização, autonomia e maturidade para resolver problemas e manter a operação fluindo.

- Conhecimento básico de controle financeiro e indicadores de operação (vendas, CMV e custos).

- Desejável conhecimento sobre vigilância sanitária e boas práticas de manipulação.

- Disponibilidade para trabalhar à noite e aos fins de semana.


Perfil desejado

- Líder presente, que saiba conduzir pessoas com equilíbrio entre exigência e escuta.

- Perfil organizado, proativo e resolutivo, que consiga tomar decisões rápidas mantendo a harmonia da equipe.

- Capacidade de manter o padrão mesmo sob pressão e volume alto de clientes.

- Boa comunicação interpessoal e foco na experiência de quem está no espaço.

- Espírito aberto, genuíno e livre de preconceitos.

- Apoia e valoriza a diversidade, a arte e a pluralidade de expressões que fazem parte do DNA da Firma.

- Afinidade com o conceito da marca: um espaço cultural e contemporâneo, onde pessoas, música, arte e boa comida se encontram.


Diferenciais

- Conhecimento em sistemas de PDV e gestão de estoque.

- Experiência com eventos, DJs, exposições e ativações culturais.

- Vivência anterior em bares ou casas que valorizem liberdade artística e público jovem e diverso.

description:

Formação superior em Engenharia Agronômica;

Experiência na produção de sementes de milho híbrido;

Conhecimento técnico em manejo de pragas, doenças, plantas daninhas e irrigação na cultura do milho;

Experiência prática em atividades de campo, incluindo plantio, despendoamento, colheita e tratos culturais;

Domínio de ferramentas digitais e do Pacote Office;

Disponibilidade para viagens e para residir em Cristalina – GO.

Nós da LongPing, buscamos promover a inclusão e incentivamos que profissionais com deficiência se inscrevam diretamente nas vagas divulgadas que tenham interesse, dentre todas as oportunidades oferecidas.


A LongPing agradece o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Quality Specialist, Brazil, 12-Month Contract
description:
Type of Role: 12 months Contract position

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Department: GDP Operational Area Quality


Looking for opportunities with purpose, impact and possibilities? Our client, Vertex, is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation. As they grow their pipeline at pace, they are strengthening their reputation for creating transformative medicines for people with serious diseases.


General Summary:

The Senior Quality Specialist (Contractor) role supports Market Quality and is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance.

This role supports GDP operations for all distribution activities within the global distribution network;
key stakeholders include Operations QA, International Supply Chain, logistics, Geographic expansion in particular support to LATAM market quality, QMS QA, Vendor Management & AIM QA.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership and provide support on QMS processes (Deviations, CAPA & Change Controls) including Root Cause Analysis, Risk Assessment, Action completion, and timely closure of records.
  • Support the intake, triage, and logging of deviations & distribution complaints into the Veeva electronic Quality Management System (VeeQMS).
  • Liaise with relevant stakeholders to obtain full information to initiate investigation and root cause analysis as per Vertex procedures. Track completion and closure in a timely manner.
  • Prepare materials for distributor sites to monitor performance on deviations, cascade information and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Support LATAM MQ team with distributor meetings and related support –
  • Including distributors KPIs and follow up and close out of action items
  • Creating list of actions for both external action items (distributors)
  • Veeva actions and related follow ups to close actions on time
  • Support MQ with SOP processing through Veeva
  • Follow up actions linked to distributor gap assessment
  • Raise risks/issues with timelines and seek support in timely resolution.
  • Support change control records as required and complete any quality actions assigned.
  • Prepare relevant QMS data reports/KPIs on Deviations, CAPA, Change Controls and Effectiveness checks, for Affiliate QMRs, inspections, ad hoc data requests and other governance meetings.
  • Support creation of, and update to, Quality Agreements with Vertex Affiliates and external vendors by;
    drafting using global templates, collation and amendment based on review comments, collection of approval signatures via DocuSign & upload to the VeeDMS system.
  • File quality records according to Vertex records retention policy and procedures.
  • Support internal audit or external audit programs and inspection readiness activities as well as tracking post-inspection readiness.
  • Support GDP operational quality in gathering relevant documentation for disposition on temperature excursions.
  • Support Self-Inspections, preparation, performance, and closure of deficiencies identified.
  • Management of International Quality inbox (intake, triage, and timely responses to QA queries).
  • Support the Responsible Person in the fulfilment of responsibilities associated with the license.


Knowledge and Skills:

  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in life sciences or technical discipline
  • Demonstrated experience with handling compliance issues, resulting from deviations or product defects.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills and able to demonstrate flexibility and adaptability.
  • Able to prioritise workload, decisive thinker able to work within agreed timescales.
  • Proactive approach and strong critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with high Level of attention to detail.
  • Utilises available digital tools and systems to enhance QA performance and efficiency.
  • Knowledge of International GDP regulations.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to drive results.
  • Continuous Process improvement mindset.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Degree in pharmacy, chemistry, medicine, biology, or a related life science
  • GDP & GMP work experience, or relevant comparable background.
  • Experience with processing deviations and CAPA in an electronic QMS tool such as Veeva or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of LATAM Countries Good Distribution Practices and/or Good Manufacturing Practices and the applicable GxP regulations and standards.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish are required
  • Resident in São Paulo, Brazil
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office applications required (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint)


Vertex is partnering with Talent Works to manage their international temporary job openings. If you are successful in your application, you will be employed by Talent Works to work on a temporary assignment at Vertex

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models;
    design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts;
    replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code;
    optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed;
    measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week;
    decreased cycle time;
    reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.G., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ;
    Postgres/Redis;
    REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends;
    write clean, testable code;
    and deploy via CI/CD toa major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics;
    you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity;
    you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.G., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.G., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.Io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.Js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.Io/Cloudflare + Docker;
    CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful;
    evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn >
    Perfect:     Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first;
    quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  1. Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  2. Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation;
    explain trade-offs.
  3. Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  4. Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description

The Data Integration Specialist designs and implements the technical infrastructure needed to consolidate the school’s data into a centralized repository. This role develops and maintains automated data pipelines, integrates multiple systems, and ensures data is structured for reporting. The specialist also supports the creation of dashboards and visualizations in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom web applications, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate data from multiple school systems and spreadsheets.Automated data pipelines (APIs, CSV, ETL processes, cloud-based tools) reducing manual work and improving accuracy.

  • Maintain and enhance data-oriented web applications based on front-end frameworks (e.G., Angular, React) and backend development (e.G., Python or .NET).

  • Collaborate with the Systems & Data Admin to validate that technical outputs meet business needs.

  • Shows humility and confidence.

title: Relationship Manager - Gerente De Relacionamento
description:
RELATIONSHIP MANAGER

SAO PAULO, BRAZIL

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Hours: Fulltime, 40 hours per week.

Who we are:

Corpag is a dynamic and international boutique trust and corporate services provider. Our goal is to remain relatively small-scaled, so that we can continue to distinguish ourselves with the personal services we offer to our clients.

Though legislation varies in different countries, Corpag’s ethical code is strict and equal worldwide. We are very happy to help companies and private individuals that are, just like us, entrepreneurial, transparent and earn their money in a sustainable and responsible manner. We are here to optimize their business and be part of their success.

At Corpag we put high emphasis on our ESG policy, by always focusing on people and the environment, in anything we do. This drives us making clear and transparent choices on the industries and clients we want to work with. As we have been a successful and healthy company for over 50 years and as making money is not our main goal, we are in a privileged position of being selective in which type of client we want to work with.

The Relationship Manager will be part of our Brazil team. The Brazil team is a cross-functional team with different backgrounds and diverse skills and perspective, handling challenges for our Brazil client portfolio, working closely together with multiple of our on- and offshore jurisdictions worldwide.

How we see you:


As a Relationship Manager, you will have the opportunity of representing Corpag towards clients and you will play a crucial role within the private and corporate client sector in Brazil. You will be entrusted with maintaining close relationships for the company with existing referral partners (feeders) and clients and ensuring legal good standing for the corporate and private structures of our clients.

Your key tasks and responsibilities are:

· Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals, family offices, corporate clients, and intermediaries, ensuring trust and long-term engagement. Identify and pursue new business opportunities with a focus on existing clients and intermediaries such as lawyers and tax advisors.

· International Structuring: Manage clients’ international structures (trusts, foundations, companies) tailored to their wealth planning, asset protection, and tax optimization needs, while liaising with legal, tax, and fiduciary professionals internally and externally across jurisdictions to implement and manage these international structures effectively.

· Regulatory Compliance & KYC: Ensure full compliance with Brazilian and international regulations, including thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) procedures.

· Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients, including documentation, due diligence, and coordination with internal teams and offshore offices.

· Portfolio Oversight: Monitor and review client portfolios and structures regularly to ensure they remain compliant, efficient, and aligned with client goals.

· Reporting & Documentation: Prepare regular reports, meeting notes, and file reviews for clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability.

· Internal Collaboration: Work closely with global legal, finance and compliance teams to deliver seamless service and resolve client issues.

We offer a varied job in an international boutique style company with an informal culture. Continuous training (tax, legal, AML and soft skills) will be part of the job and opportunities are there to develop further, in Brazil or perhaps in one of Corpag's other international offices in due course under our internal Global Mobility Program.

What you should (ideally) bring:

Ideally, you bring the following experience and interests with you:

  • Legal background (university degree);
  • 3+ years of experience in professional services, preferably in a Trust Company, Private

title: Gerente De Vendas | Microgrid
description:
Descrição da vaga



Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.


Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto.


Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. E


m 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento de mercado e pela implementação da estratégia de marketing para o negócio de microgrids no Brasil;
  • Coordenar os recursos locais, promover a implementação de projetos e ser responsável pelo acompanhamento da operação e gestão;
  • Colaborar com departamentos internos e externos para avaliar e determinar a viabilidade de soluções técnicas;
  • Reportar regularmente sobre o progresso dos negócios regionais, analisar a dinâmica do mercado e propor recomendações estratégicas de otimização.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência anterior com vendas no setor de microgrids;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excelentes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação intercultural, com capacidade de adaptação a ambientes de trabalho diversos.

  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

Requisitos e qualificações


REQUISITOS PARA COMEÇAR


Cursando graduação na área de Tecnologia da Informação (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas) com:

- Curiosidade e vontade de aprender: Disposição para explorar novas tecnologias, frameworks e metodologias de desenvolvimento.




DIFERENCIAIS QUE VÃO TE DESTACAR:


- Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe: Habilidade para interagir e colaborar efetivamente em projetos.

- Interesse em aprender sobre desenvolvimento de sistemas corporativos: Motivação para atuar em um ambiente de negócios complexo e desafiador.

- Conhecimentos em Git/GitHub: Familiaridade com controle de versão e colaboração em projetos de código.

- Projetos pessoais com .NET: Experiência prática na construção de pequenas aplicações ou protótipos utilizando a plataforma.

POR QUE ESTA OPORTUNIDADE É ÚNICA?


- Stack tecnológico de ponta: C#, .NET, SQL Server/PostgreSQL, ferramentas de CI/CD e metodologias ágeis.

- Aprendizado acelerado: Você estará imerso em tecnologias (desenvolvimento web, backend, dados, automação).

- Visão estratégica do negócio: Entender a conexão entre tecnologia, requisitos de negócio e soluções de software.

- Projetos desafiadores: Participar do desenvolvimento de sistemas robustos, escaláveis e de alta performance.

- Portfólio diferenciado: Construir projetos que combinam desenvolvimento de software, gestão de dados e arquitetura de sistemas.

Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.
